meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

copy.tagline: 管理 shadcn 组件和项目，添加、搜索、修复、调试和组合 UI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 shadcn/ui 构建 React 界面，需要管理组件和项目配置
copy.tagline_en: Manage shadcn components and projects: add, search, fix, debug, and compose UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build React UIs with shadcn/ui and need to manage components and project config

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理 shadcn 组件和项目：添加、搜索、修复、调试、美化、组装界面（含聊天界面），并提供项目上下文、组件文档和使用示例。
howto.when: 当你处理 shadcn/ui 组件、组件注册表或 preset 相关任务（如 --preset 代码），或项目带 components.json 时；也会响应“shadcn init”等指令。

say.text: 帮我添加一个按钮组件
say.note: 会先检查项目里是否已安装，再执行添加。

say.text: 搜索一下有没有现成的登录区块
say.note: 会用 shadcn 的 search 命令查注册表。

say.text: 用这个 preset 代码初始化项目
say.note: 会通过 init --preset 应用预设。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage shadcn components and projects: adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. It also provides project context, component docs, and usage examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets (e.g. --preset codes), or any project with a components.json file. Also responds to commands like "shadcn init" or "create an app with --preset".

say_en.text: Add a button component to my project.
say_en.note: It checks installed components first, then adds it.

say_en.text: Search for an existing login block.
say_en.note: It queries the registry via the CLI search command.

say_en.text: Initialize my project with this preset code.
say_en.note: It runs init --preset with the given code.
